datasets.name: garmentcodedata-v2
datasets.publisher: Maria Korosteleva et al. / ETH Zurich
datasets.image_rightsholder: Maria Korosteleva et al. / ETH Zurich, publisher-created garment geometry only
datasets.commercial_basis: Original ETH v2 deposit explicitly lists CC BY 4.0; DOI confirmed in official libdrive doi.txt. Approval limited to original garment patterns/meshes and own texture-free, body-free renders. Raw human bodies, body measurements, publisher textures and renders excluded; no third-party repack accepted.
datasets.attribution: GarmentCodeData v2, Maria Korosteleva, Timur Levent Kesdogan, Fabian Kemper, Stephan Wenninger, Jasmin Koller, Yuhan Zhang, Mario Botsch, Olga Sorkine-Hornung (ECCV 2024), ETH Zurich, doi:10.3929/ethz-b-000690432, CC BY 4.0. Coordit derives topology candidates and body-free renders.
datasets.approval_reason: Original publisher deposit license, official documentation and DOI-matching libdrive archive verified. Geometry-only scope; landmarks require explicit topology evidence; unknown points excluded. Zero training images until pilot conversion audit. Actual pilot: 15 source designs extracted; 6 explicitly selected official-training designs, 48 body-free renders. 9 mixed dresses/jumpsuits/unassigned designs excluded. Unknown and occluded seams remain masked; no flat-lay cm labels.

datasets.attribution: Nauman, F. (2024). Clothing Dataset for Second-Hand Fashion (Version 3) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.13788681. RISE, Wargön Innovation and Myrorna. datasets.approval_reason: Original-photo origin and CC BY 4.0 confirmed in original institutional deposit, original depositor project page and his official front-only mirror. Commercial training/modification allowed subject to attribution. Approval covers image rights, not nonexistent seam/mask/cm labels or release accuracy.
